testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between panels compacted by a narrow window: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:419:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between panels compacted by a narrow window ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full View ribbon displayed ✔ And the narrow window shows Appearance and Windows as compact panel buttons ✔ When the user clicks the Appearance panel button ✔ Then the temporary Appearance panel opens below the ribbon ✔ When the user clicks the Windows panel button ✔ Then the Appearance panel closes and the temporary Windows panel opens ✔ When the user clicks the Windows panel button again ✔ Then the Windows panel remains open ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the Windows panel closes ✔ And the part remains visible
